HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.
   B. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.

4. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   D. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
